subject: Control traceback & evidence snapshot for CSA review
messages:
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@solsticeins.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodai.com
Cc: audits@solsticeins.com, Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ mapping + evidence snapshot request (Solstice)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our vendor assurance cycle we need a concise CAIQ control-to-evidence mapping for the controls related to tenant isolation, key management, runtime telemetry, and deployment residency. Our audit window is late February; could you provide the following by Jan 20 so we can validate ahead of the walkthrough?

- A single spreadsheet mapping CSA/CAIQ control IDs to Redwood assertions and artifacts (prefer XLSX).
- Representative runtime telemetry samples (redacted) showing tenant isolation and KV cache behavior.
- Key management owner and rotation policy PDF or doc reference.
- Short statement about how fallbacks / model-variant routing is handled for production incidents (2–3 bullets).

If you can drop an initial package to a shared Drive link and flag owners we’ll triage internally. We may ask for a 30-minute screen share the week of Jan 26 to walk through tracebacks.

Attachments we can provide: SOC 2 summary (we'll attach once we receive mapping), and a short risk register.

Thanks,
Jennifer Park
Vendor Risk Lead | Solstice Insurance

--
Note: Please put any artifacts in the Drive link below so we can spool to our portal: https://drive.solsticeins.com/inbound/redwood
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodai.com>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@solsticeins.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodai.com, marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + evidence snapshot request (Solstice)

Jennifer — thanks, we can do this. High-level plan and owners below:

- Kimberly will own the CAIQ spreadsheet and assertions (deliverable: caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx).
- Marissa will produce runtime telemetry samples and a short playback walkthrough (deliverable: kv_cache_sample_logs.tar.gz + short README).
- Rishi will pull and redact the KMS rotation policy and provide a compliance-ready PDF (deliverable: kms_rotation_policy_v2.pdf).
- I will consolidate into a single Drive package and provide a 30-minute walkthrough slot for Jan 27 or Jan 29 — please confirm preference.

Quick clarifications:
1) For telemetry samples, we will redact tenant IDs and replace with stable pseudonyms; retention window samples will be for a 30-day slice representative of production.
2) For control tracebacks (e.g., how a request is routed to a model variant during capacity constraints), I’ll include a 2–3 bullet operational statement plus an example Jaeger trace.

We’ll upload the initial package to a Drive link (Redwood Assurance folder) by EOD Jan 16. If Solstice needs a DocuSign attestation for any of the statements, please share the envelope template and we’ll route to Legal.

Action items: Kimberly — start mapping; Marissa — grab 30-day telemetry extract; Rishi — produce KMS policy extract.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Trust & Assurance (acting)
Redwood Inference

---
On Mon, 12 Jan 2026 at 09:17 AM Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@solsticeins.com> wrote:
> [original request]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodai.com, Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@solsticeins.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ control map — initial draft and evidence list

Mina / Marissa — I attached the first draft mapping (caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx) to the Drive package and started the control-by-control notes. Highlights and open questions:

- CCM-TI-01 (Tenant isolation): pointed to namespace isolation, per-tenant KV prefixes, and network policy CIDR restrictions (artifact refs in sheet). Need confirmation: Solstice wants a sample of cross-tenant rejection logs or a logging excerpt showing a denied access event. We have an example in the telemetry extract but need to confirm acceptable redaction.
- CCM-KM-03 (Key life cycle): included KMS rotation timeline and sign-off matrix. Rishi — I included a redline request where our public doc is higher level; can you export the internal rotation playbook excerpt (non-prod step-outs removed).
- CCM-RT-02 (Runtime telemetry): added examples and the path to Jaeger traces showing model-variant fallback. Marissa — the logs are in kv_cache_sample_logs.tar.gz; the README explains pseudonym replacement.

Attachments uploaded: caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx, kv_cache_sample_logs.tar.gz (README inside), kms_rotation_policy_v2.pdf.

Jennifer — tagging you so Solstice audit team can advise if the redaction approach meets ingestion rules. If you prefer a signed attestation instead of a raw log sample for Tenant Isolation, we can coordinate DocuSign.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@solsticeins.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodai.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>
Cc: audits@solsticeins.com, Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Control traceback & evidence snapshot for CSA review

Kim / Mina — this is great, thanks for the fast turnaround. A few notes from our side after a quick pass:

- Redaction approach looks fine; we do want one short excerpt (single file) showing a denied cross-tenant request with timestamps preserved (redact tenant ids but keep time/verb/resource). If you can provide a single 100-line excerpt that demonstrates detection + rejection, that should suffice.
- For KMS rotation we prefer a signed excerpt or a link to the internal playbook with an attestation that the version is authoritative for the timeframe in question. DocuSign is fine — I’ll send a template this afternoon.
- Walkthrough: Jan 27 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team. Please send an invite.

Next steps for Redwood: upload the 100-line excerpt and confirm DocuSign envelope when ready. Tim (audit) — looping you for scheduling.

Thanks,
Jennifer Park
Vendor Risk Lead | Solstice Insurance
